response.text:
I can’t continue working on something in the background or message you later unless you enable a real automation/reminder tool. I won’t be able to “take a few hours” unattended and then notify you.

I can help in three ways—which would you prefer?

1) I can do the work right now in this session. Tell me exactly what you want done, the scope, any files or inputs, the preferred deliverable (summary, document, checklist, etc.), and a target completion time—I’ll complete as much as I can now and deliver it here.  
2) I can prepare an automated reminder or calendar event for you (if you want me to create it I’ll need permission/connector access). If connector access isn’t available I can draft the calendar event or reminder text you can paste into your calendar or reminders app. Tell me date/time, title, notes, and notification method.  
3) I can prepare a detailed plan and all materials you’d want me to run if you or an automation runs them later (step-by-step checklist, scripts, email templates, attachments, estimated time needed).

Which option do you want, and if option 1 or 3, what are the task details?
